thread:
mia: Quick check — Wed live demo final checklist. Need confirmation on: registration page fields & CTAs, Zoom settings (recording/transcript), who owns lead routing, and post-event replay/follow-up cadence. Can everyone confirm owners?

jon: I got Zoom + live ops. Plan: cloud record + auto-transcript, waiting room OFF for smoother flow, co-hosts set to present. Will enable alternative hosts: @oliver @mia. Any objections to cloud only (no local)?

priya: I own the reg page copy + thank-you page. Will add required: name, work email, company, role, use case checkbox. Adding UTM params + hidden field: campaign=live-demo-mar2026. CTA on TY page: "Add to calendar" + button to go to Zoom join link.

oliver: I can own HubSpot routing. Zapier -> HubSpot mapping ready. Rule: if company domain matches enterprise list tag as "AE_followup", else nurture. Will set lead source = "live_demo_mar2026".

mia: Nice — priorities: 1) ensure registrants get replay link within 2 hours 2) transcript + chapter markers attached 3) mark MQLs for sales follow-up 4) privacy blurb on reg form.

jon: Recording settings: cloud recording, record active speaker + gallery, enable audio transcript, save to company Zoom cloud folder "Marketing/Webinars/Live Demo Mar 2026". Retention 30 days. I'll also export VTT.

priya: TY email copy draft (short):

"Thanks for registering — join Wed 11am PT. Add to calendar: [button]. If you can't make it we'll send the replay within a few hours after the session."

mia: Good. Also add a pre-event reminder 24h and 1h with Zoom join link (no attachments). Post-event sequence: 0-2hr replay, 48hr educational email with benchmark + CTA to try API, 7-day follow-up with survey.

oliver: Zapier mapping snippet I'm pushing to the zap: 

```
trigger: new_registration_form_submission
action1: format_name_email
action2: create_contact_in_hubspot
action3: set_contact_properties: {lead_source: "live_demo_mar2026", utm_source, utm_medium}
action4: if enterprise_domain -> add_owner: "AE_pool"
```

priya: For replay access gating — do we want it behind an email check (one-click) or open link? My preference: gated for 30 days, one-click verification using the reg email. That reduces scrub.

jon: Agree gated one-click is fine. I'll add recording access link to TY Zap response, and to the replay email that oliver will trigger.

oliver: I'll create a smart list in HubSpot called "live_demo_mar2026_registrants" and a workflow to send replay immediate email (via SendGrid) triggered when Zoom recording is available. Also add property "attended" updated by Zoom webhook.

registrations-bot: new registrant alert: 12 people signed in last 2 hours (preview list available in the reg form responses).

mia: Small accessibility item — enable Auto-Captions on Zoom? We have transcripts but captions help live viewers. Jon?

jon: Zoom auto-captions = ON. We'll also pin live transcript to the recording export.

priya: I'll add a line on the reg page about captions + closed caption instructions.

mia: Analytics/UTM: add utm_campaign=live_demo_mar2026, utm_source=email|linkedin|twitter depending on source. Please make sure registration URL preserves UTMs.

oliver: Confirmed. Also will tag leads by source for follow-up sequencing.

mia: Ok owners confirmed: Zoom = jon, Reg page + copy = priya, Lead routing & follow-ups = oliver. I'll own replay sequence content and send final checklist tomorrow at 10am PT. Anything else? :thumbsup:

jon: All set from my side. Will post Zoom links and host creds by EOD.

priya: I'll publish reg page and share GA tracking IDs.

oliver: I'll test Zap + HubSpot mapping tonight and report back.

mia: Perfect — thanks team!
